clock: One event counts only for persistent units in its pre-event connected component. Cut counts for both descendants once. Snapshot every initial_node_count/4 component exposures; no unrelated-component clock or observer feedback.

calibration.positive: All buds then all collapses per period on opposite ends of a fan
calibration.null: Uniform Dyck words with equal event counts conditioned on an observed height >=8; integer completion counts, no rejection
calibration.gate: positive_median > null_median and paired one-sided sign score <=0.05 and squared signs unchanged

candidate.initialization: Uniform labeled Pruefer tree then independent uniform unit hosts among all nodes

claim_limit: Finite component-exposure recurrence of coarse growth/decomposition profiles with actual core replacement. Triangle birth, accounting invariants, net node drift and permanent fragmentation are rule consequences, not emergent physics. No matched full-law candidate null, life claim, long-term growth theorem, Lorentz symmetry or complete universe model. Fixed units omit spontaneous unit birth.
